messages.subject: Re: detection functions from previous analysis
messages.body_plain:
Hi Carissa,

Did you uncheck the option "Remove the new objects that are created with each
run" in Tools | Preferences | Analysis?  See the Distance help page (Chapter 10,
under Miscellaneous MRDS Analysis Topics) "Using a Previously Fitted Detection
Function to Estimate Density in MRDS".

If this doesn't work, email me off the list and we can sort it out and post the
solution once we have one.

Cheers - Len

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator, Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Environmental and Ecological Modelling
The Observatory, University of St Andrews, Scotland KY16 9LZ

messages.subject: Re: Set 1 and set 2 properties
messages.body_plain:
Pablo:

I am not sure which properties you are referring to, but it is unlikely
that changes transfer across sets.  Sets are merely a convenience for
organising groups of analyses.
